summary: tty_hosttest.c and n_tty_hosttest.c with 19 faults in private copies of rach2/sys/tty/tty.c, pty.c, pty.h and n_tty.c; the test runs both

argv: rm -rf ${WORK}/t && mkdir -p ${WORK}/t/tests/host && cp -R rach2 ${WORK}/t/ && cp -R ${SRC}/. ${WORK}/t/ && for t in tty n_tty; do ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -ffreestanding -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -Wno-pointer-to-int-cast -Wno-int-to-pointer-cast -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/tty -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/proc tests/host/${t}_hosttest.c ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/tty/n_tty.c -o ${WORK}/${t}_hosttest || exit; done
s=0; for t in tty_hosttest n_tty_hosttest; do ${WORK}/$t || { r=$?; [ $s -ne 0 ] || s=$r; }; done; exit $s
